patch_description: Fundamentally different from the current annealing-only approach: a two-stage hybrid. Stage 1 is a fast force-directed relaxation on the unit sphere (multi-restart, adaptive repulsion cutoff) that reliably reaches good Tammes-like configurations (~0.86 score proven in an earlier generation). Stage 2 — new — converts the best spherical configurations into a direct maximin optimization solved with SLSQP: maximize the variable t subject to dmin² ≥ t² and dmax² ≤ 1, which directly optimizes the exact evaluator metric (dmin/dmax)², not just a proxy. This lifts the pure sphere constraint, letting SLSQP fine-tune point positions freely in R³ to squeeze out extra ratio. Wrapped in try/except with a valid fallback so it always returns a finite (14,3) array.
